No, ATAP cannot be in last semester. If Sem 8 is used, Sem 7 is not last. So ATAP in Sem 7 is allowed if Sem 8 has courses. But student wants fewest semesters. But student has no more required courses. So we cannot put ATAP in Sem 7 if Sem 7 is the last semester. If we put a dummy course in Sem 8, that violates 'fewest added courses' and 'no plan satisfies all rules' if no required courses left. Actually, if no required courses are left, we cannot add courses to fill a semester (Rule 8). So we cannot create a Sem 8 with courses. Thus, ATAP cannot be in Sem 7 if Sem 7 is the last semester. And if Sem 7 is the last semester, ATAP is invalid. Therefore, no plan exists where ATAP is in Sem 7 and the student graduates as early as possible without violating the 'ATAP not in last semester' rule, unless there is a course in Sem 8. But there are no required courses left. So NO_PLAN."]}
